events.text: You spill a whole jug of wine over a famous swordsman. The tavern goes silent.

choices.text: Apologise and offer to clean his robe

effects.log: He laughs and tips you for the entertainment. (5 taels)

choices.text: Catch the jug before it lands

ok.log: Half the wine saved in mid-air. He applauds. So does the tavern.

fail.log: You slip in the wine. Now you are both wet.

events.text: Serving tables, you hear every rumour in the county. Tonight two men whisper about a hidden manual in the hills.

effects.log: You write it down after your shift. It might be worth something someday.

choices.text: Sell the rumour to the next table

effects.log: Three taels for a rumour you did not earn. (3 taels)

events.text: Two of your waiters are in love and fighting in the kitchen. Dinner service is in an hour.

choices.text: Make them work side by side

effects.log: By the end of service they are engaged. You take the credit.
Service is perfect. The kitchen is very quiet.

events.text: A tax inspector sits at your best table, orders everything, and pays with a smile that says 'audit'.

effects.log: He finds nothing, eats everything, and leaves.
He forgets his own name by the third jug. (−10 taels)

events.text: Guests refuse to sleep in room seven. They say someone knocks all night from inside the wall.

ok.log: It is a trapped bird in the chimney. You free it. Room seven is your best room now.

fail.log: Nothing. Then, at midnight, knocking. You sleep in the stable.

choices.text: Rent it cheaply to murim folk

effects.log: They love it. The knocking stops when a swordsman knocks back.

events.text: A rival family opens inns next to every one of yours, a copper cheaper.

ok.log: A year of price war. They blink first. (60 taels)

fail.log: You both lose money. The travellers win.

effects.log: Expensive, and very final.

events.text: Your water buffalo refuses to plough. It lies in the mud and looks at you with ancient patience.

effects.log: A week of back-breaking work. You are much stronger. The buffalo is rested.
It gets up. Nobody knows why. You sing every morning after that.

events.text: The best harvest in ten years. The granary is full, the pigs are fat, and the whole village is dancing.

effects.log: A good price in town. (25 taels)
Nobody in the village goes hungry this winter.

events.text: Your neighbour moved the boundary stone one step onto your field. You both know it.

effects.log: He moves it back. You move it back. This goes on for a year.

ok.log: The stone goes back, and you get a friend for the long evenings.

fail.log: The talk makes it worse. You fight in the mud.

events.text: Two families dispute a pig. The pig belongs to both of them, or neither, depending on who you ask.

ok.log: One family gets the pig, the other its piglets. Everybody is satisfied, including the pig.

fail.log: Both families are furious. The pig is fine.

effects.log: Problem solved. You now own a disputed pig. (−8 taels)

events.text: A tenant family begs you to forgive their rent: the husband broke his leg at harvest.

effects.log: They pay you back in kind for years: vegetables, labour, loyalty.
They pay. They also leave next spring.

events.text: The strongest porter on the docks challenges you to carry more sacks than him.

ok.log: Eleven sacks to his ten. The docks cheer. (+pride)

fail.log: He carries twelve. You carry nine and a lesson.

effects.log: He calls you soft. You are paid the same.

events.text: The porters want more pay. The boss wants you to break the strike.

effects.log: The boss grumbles and pays. The porters would die for you now.
You break it. Nobody eats with you at lunch any more.

events.text: A flood warning. Your warehouses are full of other people's goods.

effects.log: Two days without sleep. Nothing is lost. Your name is gold on the river.
You save the silk and lose the grain. The grain merchants remember.

events.text: A rival gang has started stopping boats on your stretch of river.

ok.log: One night, forty boats. The rival gang moves upstream.

fail.log: A long, ugly fight. You keep half the river.

effects.log: The river is quiet. The profits are smaller. Everyone lives.

events.text: Your supplier sends a shipment of silk that is half rot. Your customers arrive tomorrow.

effects.log: They buy elsewhere, and come back next season because you were honest.
A good profit, and a bad reputation that follows you for years. (30 taels)

events.text: An old woman sells a vase for almost nothing. You recognise it: an imperial kiln piece worth a fortune.

effects.log: She sells it for a fortune and gives you a tenth. (30 taels)
You sell it for a fortune. You feel slightly sick every time you pass her stall. (80 taels)

events.text: Halfway across the pass, the lead camel falls sick. The caravan cannot move without it.

effects.log: Three days lost, one camel saved.

ok.log: Ginger, warm water and a lot of patience. The camel spits on you in gratitude.

fail.log: The camel recovers on its own, despite you.

events.text: The other guild masters propose fixing the price of rice for the winter. Everyone would get rich except the poor.

effects.log: They fix it without you. You sell cheaply and are loved.
A fat winter for the guild. A thin one for everyone else. (60 taels)

events.text: The imperial treasury asks for a loan. Refusing the Emperor is not usually a long-term plan.

effects.log: The Emperor remembers your name, fondly.

ok.log: Favourable terms and a trade monopoly. The court grumbles and signs.

fail.log: The court finds your conditions insolent. A tax audit follows.

events.text: A wounded man knocks at midnight, refuses to give his name, and pays in gold.

effects.log: He leaves before dawn. A gold coin on the pillow. (20 taels)

choices.text: Treat him, then tell the constable

effects.log: He was a wanted bandit. The constable is grateful. The bandits are not.

events.text: A spotted fever spreads through the market. Everyone who can afford to is leaving town.

ok.log: You find the pattern: the market well. You close it. The fever stops.

fail.log: You treat until you fall sick yourself. The fever passes anyway.

effects.log: You come back when it is over. Some patients never look at you the same way.

events.text: Your best apprentice wants to open a hall across town. She has learned everything you taught her.

choices.text: Give her your blessing and patients

effects.log: Two halls instead of one. The town is healthier.

choices.text: Ask her to stay one more year

effects.log: She stays, resentful. She leaves anyway.

events.text: A favourite concubine collapses at a banquet. Every eye turns to you.

ok.log: Poison in the hairpin, not the food. You save her life and your own.

fail.log: You save her, barely. The court whispers that you were slow.

choices.text: Call for the court physicians together

effects.log: Many hands, shared blame. She lives.

events.text: A Demonic Cult elder and an Orthodox master arrive at your door the same night, both dying.

effects.log: They wake in adjacent beds and stare at each other all week. Neither attacks the other in your house.
The elder survives anyway, and remembers the order.

events.text: The poorest boy in your class is also the cleverest. His father wants him out working in the fields.

effects.log: Twenty years later he is a magistrate who never takes a bribe.

ok.log: The father agrees, grumbling. The boy studies by lamplight.

fail.log: The father refuses. You lend the boy books in secret.

events.text: A rich parent demands you pass his lazy son, or else.

effects.log: The son fails. The parent complains. The magistrate, whose son you also teach, backs you.
The son passes. The other children notice.

events.text: Your first posting: assistant to a magistrate who has not read a document in ten years.

choices.text: Do his job for him quietly

effects.log: The county runs well. He takes the credit. You learn everything.
He is transferred. His replacement is worse.

events.text: Two sects bring their feud to your court. Both have brought their best swordsmen as 'witnesses'.

ok.log: Both sects leave grumbling and bound by your ruling.

fail.log: One sect walks out. The feud goes on outside your courtroom.

choices.text: Make them both pay a fine

effects.log: Everyone is equally annoyed, which is the essence of justice. (30 taels)

events.text: Famine in a southern county. The imperial granary is under your seal, but opening it needs the capital's permission, which takes months.

choices.text: Open it now and write later

effects.log: Thousands eat. The capital is furious, then quietly impressed.
Permission comes. Many did not wait with you.

events.text: A powerful eunuch offers you a place in his faction. Refusing him has ended careers, and lives.

effects.log: He smiles. You triple your guards.
Promotion follows. So does the feeling of being owned.
